summary.intent: Close two ROT-07 gaps identified in Phase 68's VERIFICATION.md (an inert fail-closed rotation gate and a stale folderTree after scope-exit rotation) via GSD's gap-closure planning flow, then execute the resulting plans and re-verify the phase goal.
summary.outcome: Both gaps were planned (68-11, 68-12), verified by plan-checker, executed sequentially via subagents with TDD, and confirmed closed by a phase-goal re-verifier (14/14 must-haves passed); Phase 68 was marked complete with ROT-07 genuinely live and no regressions.

repo: SC#5 doctrine: apps/web must have zero unit spec files (`*.spec.ts`); web-side behavior is proven via SDK Vitest tests or Playwright web-e2e specs instead.
The GSD commit-helper has a known false-negative: it can report `commit_failed` while the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log`/`git status` rather than retrying.
The gap-analysis `plan:post` gate requires the correct subcommand; the first invocation attempt failed and had to be retried with the right form.
API-SURFACE.md regeneration can return 0 symbols for some phases — when uninformative, omit it from planner context rather than feeding noise.

CipherBox planning docs distinguish `deferred` (out-of-scope, carried forward) findings from newly discovered gaps — VERIFICATION.md re-runs must preserve that distinction rather than re-flagging deferred items.

code.finding: `ensureFolderLoaded` is dead code from phase 63 — it unconditionally throws 'not implemented — phase 63...' and has zero live callers, despite VERIFICATION.md naming it as the resolve chokepoint.

`reconcileFolderSequence` is the real live pre-mutation resolve gate, invoked before all four revocation-triggering mutations (rename ~742, delete ~823-824, deleteToBin ~985, move ~1765); this is where `enforceResolved`/`RotationHighWater` needed to be wired, not `ensureFolderLoaded`.
`handleSync` had a TODO leaving the background-sync path without a real `ResolveRotationContext`, a secondary bypass of the fail-closed gate alongside the SDK-internal one.

`rotateReadFromNode` previously returned `Promise<void>`, discarding the root `rotateOne` result (`childReadKey`/`newGeneration`/`newSequenceNumber`); its only production caller is `client.ts` `performScopeExitRotation`, so changing the signature to return `RotateReadResult | undefined` was backward-compatible and let `folderTree` self-heal without a page reload.

workflow: GSD gap-closure mode reads VERIFICATION.md's `status: failed` truths, skips research, and appends new numbered plans (68-11+) rather than mutating already-shipped plans (68-01..68-10).

When two gap-closure plans touch the same shared file (`client.ts`) in different functions, GSD sequences them into separate waves with `depends_on` rather than parallelizing, avoiding merge collisions.

Per stored feedback ([[feedback-gsd-concurrent-suites-ram]] and prior worktree guidance), single-plan sequential waves that both touch one shared file should run on the main working tree without worktree isolation, even when the worktree base-check reports no degrade needed.

Orchestrator subagents (planner, plan-checker, executor, verifier) each return a canonical marker (`## PLANNING COMPLETE`, `## VERIFICATION PASSED`, `## PLAN COMPLETE`, verifier `status: passed`) that the orchestrator polls for via task-notifications instead of touching files mid-run.

Post-execution regression checks used targeted test runs on the rotation surface (not the full suite) plus `tsc -b --force` diffed against a `git stash` baseline to confirm zero new type errors, rather than a full-repo regression pass.

friction: Config had `auto_advance: true` and `mode: interactive` in conflict, forcing an explicit AskUserQuestion checkpoint before auto-advancing into execution of security-sensitive fail-closed crypto code.
GSD commit-helper false-negative recurred, requiring manual git log verification instead of trusting the tool's own status output.
First attempt at the post-planning gap-analysis check used the wrong subcommand and had to be corrected.
API-SURFACE.md regeneration returned 0 symbols, adding a wasted step before being excluded from planner context.

VERIFICATION.md's originally-named Gap 1 target (`ensureFolderLoaded`) turned out to be dead stub code, requiring the planner and checker to independently re-derive the correct live chokepoint (`reconcileFolderSequence`) from source rather than trusting the verification doc's line reference.
open_items: The `CannotWriteUntilRefetchError` finding (Phase 65/66 WRITE-03/04) remains explicitly deferred/out of scope — not addressed by this gap-closure round.
Next roadmap phase is 69, pending kickoff (execution stopped after phase 68 completion per `--no-transition`).
